decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting remains distant from the firm's core building and industrial lighting knowledge, limiting its ability to assimilate and improve the product.
The spring-balanced desk lamp builds on the firm's ergonomic task lighting expertise, so existing knowledge supports learning and improvement.
General interior lighting falls directly within the firm's core building lighting domain, providing strong absorptive capacity.
The pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics is a flagship aligned with the firm's optical and energy-efficient direction.
Marine HMI searchlights rely on older non-LED technology outside the firm's LED-focused trajectory, reducing related knowledge fit.
The marine searchlight is close enough to the firm's robust outdoor and industrial lighting expertise to be improved with existing R&D.
